subsystems.name: Persistent individual state (schema, genesis, state evolution)
subsystems.evidence: All 18 Part-3.1 fields represented, heterogeneous and evolving at standard scale (standard profile 10296 rows ({'1': 10000, '2': 256, '3': 32, '4': 8}), 30 simulated days, 415728 visits by 10256 distinct visitors, 10256 distinct activated, learner_initiated=0, attention violations=0, days_with_activity=30, wall s/day [56.4, 101.7, 176.4]..[341.9, 334.0, 398.5]); same-situation utility SD 0.2; interest drift toward enjoyed content cosine 0.873 with unvisited individuals unchanged (0.0).
key_defects: employment and secondary goals evolve by daily coin flips (core.py:466-497), not experience
product usage history is 12 known-resource slots + 4 purchases; no subscriptions/recurring usage
beliefs are 8 fixed channel beliefs; knowledge is a topic vector in a closed 16-topic lexicon
no explicit personal goals beyond 6 goal codes; no commitments other than a work window
subsystems.work_needed: Make employment, goals, commitments and beliefs experience-driven and connected to the economy/labour domains; extend usage history to subscriptions and services; validate state dynamics against data where possible.

subsystems.name: Activation scheduler, attention ledger, money/bank pathway, deterministic replay of learned weights

per-day wall time grows (56 s -> ~400 s by day 30) as forum follows and entrepreneur sites accumulate
subsystems.work_needed: Keep; document the 2-hour aggregation; profile and bound per-day cost growth.

subsystems.evidence: probe_calibration.py: all 9 decisions run 'plausible:*@1' hand-set logistic coefficients. browse_session@1, continue_watching@1, purchase@1, churn@1 do not exist; content_consumption@1 and commercial_response@1 load but share no feature names with models.FEATURES, so build() silently keeps the hand model. watch_duration@1, return_daily@1, session_rate@1, news_click@1 are never referenced by the population.

FIDELITY_REGISTER.md claims six fitted models are used by 'pop (workstream B)' - false

coefficients are invented (fidelity 'plausible, unvalidated')

subsystems.name: Resource-visit engine (popweb), generated sites (popsites), text representation
subsystems.evidence: Pages are executed from deployed site code via net.fetch; site behaviours separate (probe_quality: utility rich 0.184, thin 0.110, spam 0.035, broken -0.389; 2-day return rich 0.356 vs broken 0.02); fork intervention (probe_intervention, 3 seeds) abandon gap +0.44..+0.55, p<1e-21; external agents' sites built with ordinary tools are discovered (probe_agent) and only their operator reads analytics.
key_defects: utility = closed 160-word random-index bag-of-words relevance x length/distinct-token richness (web.py:362-370, text.py:46-64): exploitable by lexicon stuffing, blind to meaning
an agent's thin site scored the same as its rich site (0.152 vs 0.147)
no semantic encoder (Gate E) wired in
text-only web + one forum; no video/audio/image consumption, no C1 platforms
willingness to pay is a product-independent constant formula (web.py:387)
sandboxed page execution dominates cost (~75%)

subsystems.name: Class-2 small adaptive neural participants
subsystems.evidence: probe_adaptive.py (3 seeds, identical-init learning vs frozen groups, controlled site switch): learning hash changes, frozen unchanged; 21-22 updates/336-352 Adam steps in 10 days; held-out MSE 0.036/0.055/0.042 vs 0.075/0.075/0.082; phase-2 utility improvement +0.111 [0.079,0.144], +0.114 [0.082,0.146], +0.153 [0.119,0.187]. 187,585 parameters (within 0.1-2M). Shared weights: one policy object per group, 256 distinct personal memories. Standard profile: max inference batch 71 over 30 days; 84 updates / 1,344 Adam steps / 85 distinct hashes in 30 days.
key_defects: network controls only the web-activity target choice; every other decision of class-2 individuals is class-1 logistic
personal GRU memory shows no benefit (with vs without memory: -0.018, -0.051, +0.028 utility)
improvement mostly general (present before the switch), adaptation to the new condition clear in 2/3 seeds only
learns to mimic the hand utility via known_sat; regression target is the hand formula
max batch 71 barely above the G.3 threshold of 64
single default policy group
subsystems.work_needed: Let the policy drive session/activity/consumption/purchase/leave decisions; train memory with multi-step (BPTT) objectives and show it matters on a test where history is needed; several independently learning groups by default; pre-registered new-condition protocol against class-1 and memoryless baselines with CIs.

subsystems.name: Class-3 strategic neural participants
subsystems.evidence: Two groups (MLP 2.16M REINFORCE/Adam, GRU 2.36M A2C/RMSprop), independent updates and freeze_copy verified (probe_frozen). Dev scale: 40/40 rewards = -0.012 (hosting cost only). Standard scale: A2C loss_before/after swings e.g. 965 -> -7040 (unnormalised advantages); ~15 decisions per member per 30 days. 30-day standard run: both groups collapse onto one price level (A 217/240 at index 1, B 225/240 at index 3); group A's last REINFORCE losses are exactly -0.0 and its 56 updates gave only 54 distinct hashes (entropy collapse, weights stopped changing); mean rewards rise in both groups (A 4.3->9.1, B 13.5->40.9 first vs second half) even after A stopped changing, i.e. market growth, no control.
key_defects: only role: entrepreneur (Part 3.2 lists ten roles)
action space = 4 categorical parameters of one scripted 'rich shop' template (strategic.py:153-156, 389-423): a bandit over a predefined decision tree, not strategy learning
unstable/unnormalised policy-gradient updates
no cooperation, no unrelated objectives, no evaluation of improvement
reward = raw balance change (fine as the agent's own observation) but too sparse at small scale
policy entropy collapse (group A deterministic, updates no longer change weights)
subsystems.work_needed: Tool-level action spaces (compose products, prices, content, hiring, investment, collaboration) through ordinary tools; several roles with differing objectives; normalised advantages, PPO-style updates, league of historical checkpoints; measured strategic improvement vs frozen and scripted baselines; integrate with multiagent (K) self-play.

critical_findings: Attention is decorative: no individual-day ever reaches its budget (standard profile mean use 4%, ~2.5 min browsing/day); 20x budgets change nothing; '0 violations' holds by construction.
Content judgement rewards lexicon tokens, not meaning: an off-topic tax article plus one keyword line beats a genuine article; synonyms halve relevance.
pop and the social engine use unrelated content spaces; the obvious export fix would run silently with random affinities (3/16 topics matched).
